evidence.title: Orangutan rescued from fire zone in Indonesia's Borneo, battles respiratory illness

occurrences.checkable_against: veterinary assessment and Karmele Llano Sanchez's statement

occurrences.subject: Sampurna orangutan

occurrences.checkable_against: eyewitness account and wildlife rescue records from the Ketapang plantation
occurrences.quote_span: On Sunday morning, Jais, a farmer in Ketapang, West Kalimantan on Borneo island - the province hardest-hit by raging forest fires - was en ​route to his farm when he found an orangutan writhing on the ground ‌in a weak state on a palm-oil plantation near the fire site.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Sampurna orangutan
